description: C/C++ node with JSON: the Reading inject sends {"temp": 21.5, "room": "lab"}. The Convert node reads fields with jsonHas, jsonNumber and jsonText and sends a new JSON object built with Json().add(…): {"room":"lab","celsius":21.5,"fahrenheit":70.7,"hot":false}. Send other JSON from the inject's MQTT topic to try it. C/C++ code runs on the board only: in ▶ Simulate the node passes the payload through.
